responsibility: Implements top-level HIR item lowering for the Rust backend. It compiles statics, constants, functions, modules, impl blocks, and extern blocks; coordinates monomorphization and duplicate-function reuse; enters constant-evaluation contexts for const items and const fns; invokes shared function and constant builders; and records the resulting backend globals, functions, and references in the compilation context for later lookups.
same_name_distinction: Defines the item compiler's behavior for each supported HIR item kind. Unlike rust-compile-item.h, this is the implementation file that performs the actual lowering work, including constant-context handling, function compilation/monomorphization decisions, extern-item dispatch, and context insertion of compiled declarations and references.
